titel: Can a company keep growing and still cut emissions

faehigkeiten.grund: Dynamik weder belegt noch ausgeschlossen: keine Merkmale gefunden, aber eine unveraenderte Wiederholungsprobe beweist nichts

einzeiler: How Jackson Family Wines tackles absolute emissions, packaging, and farming challenges.
kurzfassung: The episode explores how Jackson Family Wines balances business growth with aggressive climate targets. It examines the complexities of measuring supply chain emissions, reducing glass weight, and transforming agricultural practices. The conversation highlights the role of industry collaboration through International Wineries for Climate Action in driving sustainability.
stichpunkte: Jackson Family Wines co-founded International Wineries for Climate Action to establish standardized greenhouse gas inventories.
Absolute emissions rose due to business growth and natural crop yield variations, despite decreasing per-bottle intensity.
Baseline figures were adjusted upward after obtaining more precise supplier data on glass manufacturing emissions.
Packaging remains the largest source of emissions, prompting efforts to reduce glass bottle weight and test alternative formats.
Electrification of farming equipment proved challenging, leading the company to adopt renewable diesel for a significant portion of its tractor fleet.
Soil carbon sequestration offers a promising land-based solution, though accurately accounting for carbon remains complex.
Collaborative industry networks help leverage buying power and share practical solutions for non-traditional recycling and supply chain hurdles.

clips.text: The creation of a specialized international coalition aimed at uniting wineries worldwide to actively decarbonize the sector.
An analysis reveals that total carbon pollution figures grew significantly even as per-unit efficiency improved.

clips.hook: Electric tractors struggling in the field
clips.text: Initial attempts to transition heavy agricultural machinery to electric power failed due to inadequate performance on steep terrain and heavy towing.

clips.hook: Two-thirds of emissions from three major areas
clips.text: Packaging, agricultural operations, and product transport together constitute the vast majority of the company's carbon footprint.

clips.hook: 十四 million kilowatt hours of rooftop solar
clips.text: Substantial investments in onsite renewable energy generation have brought extensive photovoltaic arrays into active operation.

beschreibung:
Caroline Merrell, senior director of sustainable winemaking at Jackson Family Wines, shares how her company set a science-based climate target, the challenges of reducing emissions in a growing business, and the actions working now such as using less glass in wine bottles, installing solar on farms, and looking at supply chain emissions.
Take action at work with SHIFT’s science based targets guide: https://jointheshift.earth/climate-actions/work-sbt
Subscribe or follow Climate Actually right here on this platform to catch every episode.
